$comment: Files and routes that use the Mindy public design system. scripts/audit-public-design.mjs lints every entry in `files` (directories are walked). scripts/verify-public-site.mjs runs runtime checks on `runtimeRoutes`; scripts/verify-public-parity.mjs diffs raw HTML for `parityRoutes`. A route migration adds its owning files and routes here in the same PR. The homepage is listed as /today: getmindy.ai/ rewrites there by host, so on localhost / is a different page.
